comments.note: Edge case — explicit null Connections in JSON: STJ will override the Array.Empty<DatabaseConnectionOptions>() property initializer if JSON contains "Connections": null, producing a null reference at runtime despite the non-nullable type annotation. This won't occur via the normal save path (SaveAsync always serializes the list properly), but a manually edited settings file could trigger it. Recommend the Reviewer consider adding a [JsonIgnore(Condition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull)] or a null-coalescing guard on read. Not a blocker for this WP.

BLOCKING: DatabaseOptions.Connections is typed IReadOnlyList<DatabaseConnectionOptions> (non-nullable) but System.Text.Json will override the Array.Empty<>() property initializer with null when a JSON file contains '"Connections": null'. This violates the non-null type contract and creates a latent NullReferenceException for every future caller. AC-1 marked not-met because the nullable annotation does not accurately reflect runtime behavior.

comments.note: [BLOCKING] DatabaseOptions.Connections is typed IReadOnlyList<DatabaseConnectionOptions> (non-nullable) but System.Text.Json will set the property to null at runtime when JSON contains "Connections": null, defeating the Array.Empty<DatabaseConnectionOptions>() initializer. This violates the non-null contract and produces a latent NullReferenceException for any future caller that uses .Connections without a defensive null check. Two recommended fix options — (A, preferred) change the type annotation to IReadOnlyList<DatabaseConnectionOptions>? to be honest about runtime behaviour, then update callers to use the null-coalescing operator; (B, infrastructure guard) in JsonSettingsService.LoadOrInitialise(), after deserialization apply `options = options with { Database = options.Database with { Connections = options.Database.Connections ?? Array.Empty<DatabaseConnectionOptions>() } }` to normalize null back to empty before returning. Option A is recommended because it corrects the false promise at its source in the model layer.

DatabaseOptionsTests.cs names its temp-directory helper TempDir; the sibling file JsonSettingsServiceTests.cs uses TempDirectory. Rename TempDir to TempDirectory when reworking to keep the test project consistent.

[documentation-forward] DatabaseConnectionOptions.Id defaults to Guid.NewGuid(). The XML doc on the property (or a class-level summary note) should explicitly state that two instances constructed via new DatabaseConnectionOptions() will never be record-equal due to differing Ids. This prevents future contributors from writing equality-based tests that silently fail.

[documentation-forward] DatabaseConnectionOptions.Password stores credentials as plaintext in the user settings file. The existing XML doc comment says 'stored at the user's discretion' but this should also be surfaced in the README or user-facing documentation so end users understand the security trade-off before entering sensitive credentials.
